name: smart-finder
description: Persian-language real-estate discovery and alert platform (Tehran)

scripts.build:packages: tsc --build packages/shared/tsconfig.build.json packages/normalizer/tsconfig.build.json packages/matching/tsconfig.build.json packages/telegram/tsconfig.build.json packages/database/tsconfig.build.json apps/worker/tsconfig.build.json
scripts.watch:packages: tsc --build packages/shared/tsconfig.build.json packages/normalizer/tsconfig.build.json packages/matching/tsconfig.build.json packages/telegram/tsconfig.build.json packages/database/tsconfig.build.json --watch
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @smart-finder/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.clean: tsc --build --clean packages/shared/tsconfig.build.json packages/normalizer/tsconfig.build.json packages/matching/tsconfig.build.json packages/telegram/tsconfig.build.json packages/database/tsconfig.build.json apps/worker/tsconfig.build.json
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
